answer.reason: The street before the Water Gate is where the people gathered and Ezra read the law to them, which is more than the summary says.

clauses.english: was where Ezra read the book of the law to all the people
clauses.quote: he read therein before the street that was before the water gate

doubts: NEH 3:26 and NEH 12:37 only place the gate and add nothing to the summary, so they are not used.
NEH 8:16 mentions booths built in the street of the water gate, but this is a minor detail of the feast, so it is left out.
